hub.title: Warehouse Inbound Process Centre
hub.description: Start order-based, orderless and direct inbound flows with the same domain rules; trace every step from task assignment to quality and stock movement.

start.title: Start Inbound
start.description: Choose the correct entry point for the document source and execution mode.

execute.title: Execute the Task
execute.description: Assign operators, accept assigned work and manage physical progress.

manage.title: Monitor and Manage
manage.description: Use records and policies for full traceability and configurable process control.

fromOrder.title: Create from Purchase Order
fromOrder.description: Select Netsis purchase orders, reserve open quantities and create an inbound task.

orderless.title: Orderless Inbound Task
orderless.description: Create a planned task with dispatch and stock lines without an order link.

direct.title: Direct Inbound
direct.description: Post an orderless inbound atomically with quality, quarantine and stock movement.

tasks.title: Tasks and Assignments
tasks.description: Assign open tasks to one or more operators and monitor their progress.

assigned.title: My Assigned Tasks
assigned.description: Accept, start and complete inbound tasks assigned to you.

records.title: Inbound Records
records.description: Monitor all inbound modes in the shared server-side data grid.

settings.title: Inbound Settings
settings.description: Manage overage, shortage, quality hold, approval and ERP posting policies.

title: Goods Receipt from Orders
subtitle: Select Netsis orders, validate quantities, and reserve a receiving task safely.
assignedSelf: The task will be assigned to the signed-in user.
configurationHint: Select a target warehouse, receiving location, and document series to continue.

createFlow.subtitle: Manage order selection, line-level warehouse and location planning, and lot/serial traceability in one controlled flow.

manual.directSubtitle: Validate the document and post receipt, quality and stock movement in a controlled flow.
manual.orderlessSubtitle: Create a planned receipt task without an order link.

document.title: Document and Supplier
document.description: Validate the dispatch type, number and supplier behind the receipt.

operation.title: Warehouse and Process
operation.description: Choose receiving location, series, priority and label method.

lines.title: Stocks to Receive
lines.description: Enter stock, configuration, quantity and traceability by line.

review.title: Final Review
review.description: Verify document and quantity summary before posting.

manual.eReceiptHint: Enter exactly 15 alphanumeric characters for the e-dispatch/GIB number.
manual.noLines: No stock lines have been added.

validation.receiptNo: Standard dispatch receipt number must contain exactly 15 digits.
validation.eReceiptNo: e-Dispatch number must contain a 3-character unit code followed by 13 digits.
validation.operation: Warehouse, receiving location and document series are required.
validation.lines: At least one stock line is required.
validation.stock: Stock and a quantity greater than zero are required.
validation.serialQuantity: A serial-tracked line must have quantity 1.
validation.expiry: Expiration date cannot precede manufacturing date.
validation.incomplete: The form contains missing or invalid fields.
validation.submit: Goods receipt could not be created.

policy.title: Goods Receipt Process Policy
policy.description: Centrally manage over/under receipt, operation approval, the quality gate, stock availability and ERP posting timing.

fields.erpPosting: When is the ERP record posted?

toggles.holdInventoryUntilQualityDecision: Hold stock until the quality decision
toggles.blockPutawayUntilQualityDecision: Block putaway until the quality decision

policy.hint: These settings are written to the task header as a snapshot when it is created. Even if the setting changes later, an in-progress task completes under the same rules.
